title: Several tables: entity targets as of a cutoff
description: Customers with their orders and tickets in separate tables: will a customer stop, buy or call in the days after a date?
reliability: rows left out because the horizon passes the data's end
question: Which decisions does DCLab reach on a several tables: entity targets as of a cutoff problem (Customers with their orders and tickets in separate tables: will a customer stop, buy or call in the days after a date?), and do they hold?
hypothesis: Each decision a careful data scientist reaches on this kind of problem holds on every seed of the kind's replica.
setup_summary: The several tables: entity targets as of a cutoff kind's replica on seeds 0, 1, 2, brought as a person would; its own machine in dclab_core solve it, and each decision is checked on the finished run. No model is called.
